tim_witness.character_reading: Tim's Chronicle/project material consistently places Highly Regarded near encouragement, hype, apprenticeship and ordinary companionship. He is present in the dense early-November Garden/voice-chat field and later appears at the November 19 Garden-conflict boundary, so the file should keep both support and exposure to fracture visible.

fruit.reading: The dominant Tim-witness fruit is supportive: helping sustain energy, belonging and the idea of becoming a better Potato. Later conflict proximity complicates but does not erase that.

karma.reading: No explicit individual karma balance is recovered. In Tim's own grammar, encouragement, support and apprenticeship are generative; merely appearing near conflict is not treated as negative karma by itself.

placement.reading: Best placed near Garden/Saloon companionship with a later boundary exposure rather than in a fixed lower-world role.
